# Red Brick

Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/red_brick
Author: Rob Tuytel
License: CC0 — https://polyhaven.com/license

Downloaded 1K diffuse, OpenGL normal, roughness and ambient occlusion maps from Poly Haven. Mask.png packs metallic=0, restrained AO, detail mask=0.5 and inverse roughness for HDRP. Workshop relief geometry samples individual clay faces from these maps; it is original project geometry.
